Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Documentary evidence shall be su bmitted along with the bid. (https://level.bifma.org/). k) AIOTA for Education Furniture Range, Office Furniture in cluding Seating Systems, Storage System range Certificat e: any two out of the three certifications. The same shall be available on the official AIOTA website.

7. The bidder or its OEM shall submit the Manufacturing Factory License and Trademark certificate. A copy of both documents s hall be enclosed as proof of compliance. 8. The bidder or its OEM must submit valid BIS License copies for IS 17631,17632, 17633, 17634, and 17635 for 2022. 9. The OEM must be producing furniture products certified under the India Design Mark (by the Indian Design Council), with at le ast one product certified in each of the last three years—proof t o be attached. 10. OEM must have an OEM/OEM authorised service centre in Odis ha. However, in case of the address of the OEM authorised serv ice centre, proof of authorisation has to be produced on the OE M letterhead. 11. CNC Router Machine, Power Press Machine (Capacity from 10 Ton to 250 Ton), Pipe Cutting Machine, Pipe Bending Machine – CNC, Hydraulic Brake Press Machine (Sheet Bending Machine) - 10 Feet, Power Shearing Machine, Turret Punch Pr ess Machine, Laser sheet processing machine, Hot Press for la minate pressing, Post Forming Machine, Spindle Moulder Mac hine, MIG Welding Machine, Welding Machine, Powder coating plant with a minimum of 8 Tank pre-treatment mechanism The OEM/Bidder should submit a Third Party Feasibility R eport regarding the machinery, which must be from any of the Inspection /certification bodies listed under NABCB. The same will be verified from the NABCBwebsite. 12. A bid compliance undertaking must be submitted by bidder/O EM citing that all items will be provided as per the attached spe cifications. 13. There was a tolerance of ±5% in the specification is allowed. 14. The product warranty will be one year for manufacturing defec ts.Undertaking from OEM letterhead should be produced. 15. Rates per unit of furniture must be quoted inclusive of supply

& installation, transportation/deliverytothe site. 16. This is a bunch bid, so the bidder must quote for all the items; a single-item quotation will not be acceptable. 17. Non-compliance with tender terms, non- uploading of required documents, lack of clarity of the specifications, contradiction & supporting literature, etc. and submission of forged information may lead to rejection. 18. The buyer reserves the right to accept/reject any/all bids with out assigning any reasons therefor. All relevant documents with respect to the above points must be u ploaded with the tender documents. The bidder has to quote and s upply the materials as per the specification sheet attached in the b id-specific ATC with an overall tolerance of ±5%. . 4.
